source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Astorath’s unit gains [[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/devastating-wounds) on melee attacks for the turn it made a Charge move. The grant applies only against targets with neither the **VEHICLE** nor the **MONSTER** keyword.
